skill.name: frontend-design

- **Editorial/Magazine**: Bold typography, grid layouts, dynamic composition

- Create atmospheric backgrounds instead of solid colors

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces weaken product identity and usability. This skill guides purposeful visual direction, responsive implementation, motion, accessibility, and production-ready frontend code.
actual_capabilities: Defines a clear visual direction from the product purpose, audience, and technical constraints.
Guides typography, color, spacing, composition, backgrounds, and visual detail choices.
Provides CSS and React examples for animation, layered backgrounds, and interface composition.
Adapts implementation complexity to minimalist or maximalist design goals.
Requires responsive behavior, WCAG AA accessibility, performance, and functional code.
Supplies a quality checklist for reviewing visual coherence and production readiness.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a complete component library or reusable design system.
Its examples require adaptation to the project framework, brand, content, and browser support.
It does not automatically test accessibility, performance, responsiveness, or interaction behavior.
Distinctive fonts, motion libraries, and visual assets may require separate licensing or installation.

use_cases.title: Launch a Distinctive Product Page
use_cases.description: Create a responsive product page with a focused visual identity, clear hierarchy, purposeful motion, and accessible interactions.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Generic Interface
use_cases.description: Transform a familiar layout through stronger typography, composition, color, and details while preserving usability.

use_cases.title: Build a Polished Portfolio
use_cases.description: Develop a memorable portfolio with expressive art direction, responsive presentation, and production-ready implementation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a responsive page for [product]. Use [brand qualities] as the visual direction. Include accessible navigation, clear hierarchy, and one purposeful animation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused single-page interface

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign [page or component] for [audience]. Preserve [required workflows]. Improve typography, spacing, color, responsiveness, accessibility, and visual identity.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate improvement of an established interface

prompt_templates.title: Build a React Experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a production-ready React interface for [use case]. Define the aesthetic direction first. Implement responsive layouts, interaction states, and restrained motion.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Complete Frontend System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a frontend system for [product] and [users]. Establish reusable visual rules, responsive components, accessibility criteria, motion behavior, and performance constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert request spanning design direction and implementation standards

output_examples.input: Design a landing page for an independent music studio.
output: A bold editorial direction built around artist photography and high-contrast typography.
A responsive page hierarchy covering releases, studio services, featured work, and contact actions.
Purposeful transitions that support browsing without delaying access to content.

output_examples.input: Refresh a generic analytics dashboard for operations teams.
output: A quiet utilitarian direction optimized for scanning, comparison, and repeated actions.
Clear information hierarchy with restrained color, stable controls, and accessible status indicators.
Responsive behavior that preserves primary metrics and workflows on narrow screens.

output_examples.input: Create a portfolio for a motion designer.
output: An expressive gallery direction that makes project media the primary visual signal.
A concise project structure with case studies, credits, process notes, and contact information.
Motion choreography that demonstrates expertise while respecting reduced-motion preferences.

best_practices: Define the audience, purpose, constraints, and visual direction before implementation.
Use motion, typography, and visual effects to strengthen hierarchy and user understanding.
Verify responsive behavior, accessibility, performance, and functional interaction states before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not apply fashionable fonts, gradients, or layouts without a product-specific reason.
Do not add elaborate animation that delays content, obscures controls, or ignores reduced-motion settings.
Do not claim production readiness without testing accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and core workflows.

faq.question: Which frontend frameworks does this skill support?
faq.answer: The guidance is framework-independent, with examples using CSS, React, Tailwind-style classes, and Framer Motion.

faq.question: Does it generate complete working interfaces?
faq.answer: It directs the assistant to produce functional code, but completeness depends on the supplied requirements, project context, and available assets.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires WCAG AA accessibility, responsive behavior, clear interactions, and production review.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing design?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current implementation, required workflows, audience, brand constraints, and the problems that need improvement.

faq.question: Does it install fonts or animation libraries?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends suitable approaches, while dependency installation and font licensing remain separate project tasks.

faq.question: How should generated work be validated?
faq.answer: Test the interface across target viewports, keyboard navigation, assistive technology, reduced motion, performance budgets, and core workflows.
